items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: he started using Charlie Bocchage on the last. Charlie Bocchage was playing banjo.

ctx.x: No, but did you have a bass player? No.
No. Just on the last, he was using Peter Bocchage's brother on bass. The Charlie, Charlie. Charlie, Charlie, Charlie. Then he started using Charlie Bocchage on the last.
